azure-devops.comment: Launched via `node` against the locally installed package rather than `npx`, so it starts identically on Windows, Linux, and macOS. A bare `npx` cannot be spawned on Windows (npx is a .cmd shim, and MCP clients spawn without a shell), which is why this previously needed a `cmd /c` wrapper that in turn broke on Linux. Running the installed copy also pins the version instead of letting `npx -y` fetch latest on every launch. Requires `npm ci`.
